transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer service, my name is Gary. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Gary. I am absolutely furious. I cancelled my S-Net broadband back in July, sent the equipment back, and today I see a direct debit of fifty-four pounds ninety taken from my account!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Right, I can look into your account records, but I need to get through security first. Can you give me your full name and the first line of your address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Declan Doherty, 44 Windmill Court, Leeds, LS6 2TR.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And can you confirm the four-digit security PIN on the account, Declan?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what was the contact telephone number listed on the contract?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Let me pull up the billing ledger for your cancelled account. Bear with me for a moment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting. I can see the account ceased on July twenty-fourth, but an automated equipment recovery fee was triggered on October fifteenth.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: An equipment fee? That's ridiculous! I posted the router back in the prepaid box the very next week after cancellation!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well, that direct debit was generated automatically by the central finance platform. That's entirely handled by automated banking clearing, so it's not our department's problem if the direct debit mandate was left open.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What do you mean it's not your problem? S-Net took money from my current account without permission!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you don't keep track of your own bank mandates, you can hardly expect us to mind your bank account for you.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Are you serious? You told me in your cancellation letter that S-Net would close the direct debit once the final statement cleared!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: As I said, the warehouse system had not marked the serial number as checked in, which is why the charge generated.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have the Royal Mail tracking slip right here in my hand from August third. Delivered and signed for at your logistics centre in Rugby.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, give me that Royal Mail tracking number then.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is JZ 441 902 881 GB.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me write that down. JZ 441 902 881 GB, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what date did you drop it off at the Post Office branch?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: August first, around lunchtime. The post office on Headingley Lane.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hold on while I check the logistics depot database. Bear with me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks for bearing with me, Declan. I've located the parcel intake in Rugby. The barcode was scanned on August fifth, but the depot clerk failed to link the asset tag to your account profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So your warehouse made a mistake, and you took fifty-five quid out of my pocket three months later. I cannot believe the sheer incompetence of this company!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The system showed an unreturned Hub 4. That is why the billing run processed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I want that money refunded back to my bank immediately. I have mortgage payments due on Friday.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I cannot do an instant BACS recall. Standard bank refund takes three to five working days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you refund it to my debit card directly? Your colleague did that once when there was an overcharge last year.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can check if the merchant gateway allows an immediate card refund. What are the last four digits of the card registered on file?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm, Declan, that's the Visa debit ending in 4102 that was used for your monthly payments?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's the one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the expiry date showing on the front of that card?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: November twenty-seven.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: One moment while I process the credit authorization. Bear with me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience. I have processed an immediate refund of fifty-four pounds ninety pence back to your Visa ending 4102.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How quickly does that card transaction show up?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Card merchant refunds usually reflect in available funds within two hours, depending on your bank's clearing cycle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Has the direct debit mandate been cancelled on your side as well?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I have locked the billing profile to archived status and cancelled the direct debit instruction with BACS.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will I get any further letters or collection notices about this?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, the account balance is now at absolute zero, and the equipment flag is marked as returned.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you send me an email confirmation so I have written proof of the refund and closure?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am generating the formal credit memo right now. It is being sent to your email on file, d.doherty at fastmail dot co dot uk.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me check my phone to make sure it arrives before we finish this call.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Take your time, let me know when your inbox updates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Still waiting for it to come through. It usually takes a minute.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was dispatched from our billing mailer thirty seconds ago.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, the email just popped up. Credit note reference CN-88219 for fifty-four pounds ninety.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you confirm you see the zero balance and the refund confirmation on that document?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I can see the transaction reference and the refund amount clearly. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you can see that the direct debit mandate cancellation is noted at the bottom?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it says direct debit instruction cancelled with BACS reference 9904.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Declan?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, as long as no more surprise charges appear, that's everything sorted.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. Thank you for choosing S-Net, goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Gary.
